attributes.action: Street Lights and CCTV at Jeanfield Cemetery
attributes.additional_details: Petition to get cctv and street lights in Perth Jeanfield Cemetery. To protect our loved ones and the cemetery from thieves, vandals and arsonists - and the general public safety when visiting their loved ones.
attributes.background: To install cctv and lights in Perth Jeanfield Cemetery

rejection.details: This is a local matter which is the responsibility of the local authority/council.  Please contact them or your local MP.
